title: Jack Rabbit Cyber Rabbit Xenon E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: Jack Rabbit’s Cyber Rabbit Xenon is a bold combination of two fruits that play together perfectly. Pomegranate lends its exotic tang to the exhale while the juicy, sweet blueberry provides an exquisite, deeply fruity exhale. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
